standard.summary: loss-driven 与 uniform 混合 (1=纯 loss-driven，0=纯 uniform)。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Blends loss-driven against uniform sampling (1 = purely loss-driven, 0 = purely uniform).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: loss-driven 与 uniform 混合 (1=纯 loss-driven)。

advanced_en.principle: Blend between loss-driven and uniform (1 = pure loss-driven).
